basic_details.job_title: NSIC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 41 Chief General Manager, Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC), a Schedule 'A' Mini-Ratna Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, has 41 regular posts across nine posts, from Assistant Manager (E-0) to Chief General Manager (E-7), on IDA 2017 pattern pay scales. Apply online through the CAREER section of www.nsic.co.in. The online link is active from 21 November 2026 and the last date is 14 December 2026. The signed print-out with a detailed CV must reach NSIC by 6:00 p.m. on 21 December 2026.

qualification.details: Law & Recovery: Graduate with First class LL.B degree or First class Five Years Integrated Law degree with minimum 60% marks (5% relaxation in marks to SC/ST/PwBD). Contract & Procurement: First class B.E./B.Tech with minimum 60% marks (5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) in Mechanical/Electrical/Civil, OR Graduate with Two years MBA (First Class with minimum 60% marks, 5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD). Rajbhasha (Deputy Manager / Rajbhasha Adhikari): Post Graduate degree with 50% marks (5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) in Hindi with English as compulsory or elective subject at Graduate level, OR Post Graduate degree with 50% marks in English with Hindi as compulsory or elective subject at Graduate level; AND one year Diploma/Certificate course in translation from English to Hindi and vice versa, OR three months full time training on translation from Central Translation Bureau. Preference to candidates with experience in organizing Hindi workshops, trainings and seminars on progressive use of Hindi. Business Development: Graduate with Two years MBA (First Class with minimum 60% marks, 5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) with specialization in Marketing/Finance. Technology (Civil): First class B.E./B.Tech with minimum 60% marks (5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) in Civil Engineering.

how_to_apply: Apply online through the CAREER section of www.nsic.co.in. The link is active from 21 November 2026.

Stage 1: register with name, mobile number, email ID and date of birth. Verify the email ID through the email received, log in to the recruitment portal and fill basic details. Fill first name, middle name and surname; abbreviations must not be used where indicated.
Stage 2: upload self-attested copies of the documents listed below. The photograph (colour, white background, recent) and signature must be in JPG/JPEG/PNG format and less than 100kb.
Stage 3: pay the application fee through NEFT, as applicable.
Stage 4: an Application Number for the post applied for is issued and sent to the registered mobile number by SMS/email. Keep it for all future references.
Take the print-out on A-4 size paper and sign it where indicated.

Send the print-out with a detailed CV and the self-attested documents by Ordinary Post, Registered Post, Speed Post, Courier or by hand to: Deputy General Manager – Human Resources, The National Small Industries Corporation Limited, "NSIC Bhawan", Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi-110020. Telephone 011-26926275, email [email protected].
The hard copy must be received by 21 December 2026, up to 6:00 p.m. Copies received after 6:00 p.m., or after 21 December 2026, will not be considered for short-listing.

Incomplete applications are summarily rejected, and no request to add information after submission is entertained. Candidates must keep their email ID in operation for at least one year; NSIC is not responsible for non-delivery or late delivery of email.

The fee is paid through NEFT only, to Name: National Small Industries Corporation Limited, Bank: State Bank of India, A/c No. 43207132490, IFSC: SBIN0004298, Address: Commercial Branch, 6th Floor, IFCI Tower, Nehru Place, Delhi. No other mode of payment is accepted. Applications without the application fee (where it applies) are straightaway rejected, and the fee is non-refundable even if the candidature is rejected for any reason or the candidate is not shortlisted for interview.
Aadhaar card and PAN card; passport size photograph and signature.

Class X Certificate/School Leaving Certificate as proof of date of birth; for a change of name, Gazette notification or national newspaper clipping with an affidavit giving the previous and changed name.
Mark-sheets of each year or consolidated mark-sheet and degree of Graduation/Post Graduation; passing certificate; proof of the university norms for converting CGPA/OGPA/DGPA to percentage.

Caste certificate (SC, ST, OBC, EWS) and PwBD certificate, if applicable. The OBC certificate must show Non-Creamy Layer status and must be issued within the year 2026, before the last date of the online application. OBC candidates also submit a declaration in the format printed in the notice.

Experience: service certificate showing start and end of employment, OR appointment/offer letter with resignation or relieving letter or a stamped and signed salary slip; income tax returns with 26 AS; salary slips or salary certificates.

Certificate showing the scale of pay/grade pay/gross monthly salary for November 2024 to October 2026; Hierarchy Certificate where experience is in organisations whose pay scales are not comparable with CDA/IDA; detailed CV.

content_sections.heading: About NSIC
content_sections.text: The National Small Industries Corporation Ltd. describes itself as a Schedule 'A' premier Mini-Ratna Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. Its office is at NSIC Bhawan, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi. The posts are regular appointments in various functional areas of the Corporation, and for all posts preference is given to candidates from CPSEs/Govt./Deemed Govt. Institutions.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 41 vacancies in nine posts. The category break-up below is as printed, and the figures add up to the total for every post. The notice does not give a separate vacancy count for each functional area of the Deputy General Manager (Technology and Business Development) and Deputy Manager (Law & Recovery, Contract & Procurement, Rajbhasha, Business Development and Technology (Civil)) posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. Eligibility for upper age limit, qualification and experience is determined as on the closing date of the online application, 14 December 2026. One candidate can apply for one post only. The notice prints an upper age limit for each post; age relaxation is "applicable as per Govt. Rules" and the notice gives no further detail. Law & Recovery: Graduate with First class LL.B degree or First class Five Years Integrated Law degree with minimum 60% marks (5% relaxation in marks to SC/ST/PwBD). Contract & Procurement: First class B.E./B.Tech with minimum 60% marks (5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) in Mechanical/Electrical/Civil, OR Graduate with Two years MBA (First Class with minimum 60% marks, 5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD). Rajbhasha (Deputy Manager / Rajbhasha Adhikari): Post Graduate degree with 50% marks (5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) in Hindi with English as compulsory or elective subject at Graduate level, OR Post Graduate degree with 50% marks in English with Hindi as compulsory or elective subject at Graduate level; AND one year Diploma/Certificate course in translation from English to Hindi and vice versa, OR three months full time training on translation from Central Translation Bureau. Preference to candidates with experience in organizing Hindi workshops, trainings and seminars on progressive use of Hindi. Business Development: Graduate with Two years MBA (First Class with minimum 60% marks, 5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) with specialization in Marketing/Finance. Technology (Civil): First class B.E./B.Tech with minimum 60% marks (5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) in Civil Engineering. Experience of handling various HR functions including Manpower Planning, Recruitment, Reservation policy, Employee relations, Grievance redressal mechanism, Establishment matters etc. Should be able to handle policy intervention, training and development, succession planning, employee engagement, performance appraisal, career progressions, industrial relations and related HR functions. Preferably experience of Administration aspects like tendering and procurement procedures. Technology: sound technical knowledge and hands-on experience in Industry 4.0 and associated emerging technologies (Industrial Automation, Robotics, Mechatronics, Additive Manufacturing, IIoT, Sensor Technologies, Smart Manufacturing), preferably involving implementation and management of technology-based projects; OR sound knowledge and hands-on experience in Computer Science, IT and Industry 4.0-related technologies (AI, ML, IoT, Cloud Computing, Big Data Analytics, Cyber Security, Industrial Software Solutions, Digital Transformation). content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay scales are in the IDA pattern (2017). The compensation package includes basic pay, Industrial DA, HRA, perquisites and allowances as per the cafeteria approach, EPF and gratuity, as per IDA 2017 pattern, with Performance Related Pay as admissible and as per Rules of the Corporation. The Corporation also has policies on House Building Advance, Vehicle Advance, Computer Advance, medical facilities for self and dependents, PF, gratuity, Superannuation Pension Scheme and leave encashment. These are regular appointments. A selected candidate must execute an agreement to serve NSIC for a minimum of 2 years after joining, failing which the incumbent is liable to compensate NSIC Rs.2,00,000/-. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad where the Corporation may have business interests, and the Transfer and Promotion policy applies to new recruits at the time of their promotion.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection stages depend on the post. The notice does not give an interview date. Selection consists of a Written Test (Computer Based Test) with 70% weightage and a Personal Interview of shortlisted candidates with 30% weightage. The test has 100 multiple choice questions for 100 marks. Each correct answer carries 1 mark, with 0.25 negative marking for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40 for General/OBC candidates and 35 for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Candidates are shortlisted for the interview in the ratio of at least 1:5 or at most 1:7 with respect to the number of posts advertised. Management reserves the right to devise its criteria, including raising the minimum eligibility standards, to restrict the number of candidates called. The decision of Management on eligibility, interview and selection is final and binding. Outstation SC/ST candidates who are not permanent employees of Govt./Semi-Govt./Banks/PSUs/Local Bodies are reimbursed To and Fro IIIrd AC (other than Rajdhani) train fare by the shortest route on production of documentary evidence, only on attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 41 regular vacancies in nine posts: Chief General Manager 1, Deputy General Manager 3, Chief Manager 5, Manager (E-2) 2, Manager (F&A) 6, Deputy Manager 7, Deputy Manager (F&A) 4, Assistant Manager (Technology) 11 and Assistant Manager (F&A) 2.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of the online application is 14 December 2026. The signed print-out with a detailed CV must be received by 6:00 p.m. on 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NSIC Assistant Manager (Technology)?
faq.answer: A first class 4 years B.E./B.Tech degree with minimum 60% marks (5% relaxation to SC/ST/PwBD) in the listed engineering branches is required. Only GATE qualified candidates shall apply, and GATE scores of 2025 and 2026 are considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NSIC posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years for Chief General Manager, 41 for Deputy General Manager, 38 for Chief Manager, 34 for both Manager posts, 31 for both Deputy Manager posts and 28 for both Assistant Manager posts, counted as on 14 December 2026. Relaxation is as per Govt. Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1500 per application, paid through NEFT only. SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and Departmental candidates pay no application fee, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the CAREER section of www.nsic.co.in, pay the fee if applicable, and take the print-out of the form with the Application Number. Send it with a detailed CV and self-attested documents to the Deputy General Manager – Human Resources at NSIC Bhawan, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi-110020.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For posts 1 to 7 it is scrutiny of applications and Personal Interview. For Assistant Manager (Technology) it is 70% GATE score and 30% interview. For Assistant Manager (F&A) it is a CBT (70%) and interview (30%).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay scales are in the IDA 2017 pattern: Rs.1,00,000-2,60,000 for Chief General Manager (E-7), Rs.70,000-2,00,000 for Deputy General Manager (E-4), Rs.60,000-1,80,000 for Chief Manager (E-3), Rs.50,000-1,60,000 for Manager (E-2), Rs.40,000-1,40,000 for Deputy Manager (E-1) and Rs.30,000-1,20,000 for Assistant Manager (E-0).

faq.question: Q9. Is there a written exam in NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A Computer Based Test of 100 questions, 100 marks and 90 minutes is held only for Assistant Manager (F&A) (E-0), with 0.25 negative marking per wrong answer. The other posts are filled by scrutiny and interview, or GATE score and interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post, and is there a service bond?
faq.answer: One candidate can apply for one post only. A selected candidate must sign an agreement to serve NSIC for a minimum of 2 years after joining, failing which the candidate is liable to pay Rs.2,00,000/- compensation.
